input_text: A girl from a shanty, Pooja, learns from a genetic test that nurses switched her with the baby of a wealthy household soon after the two were born. The wealthy household takes her in yet regards her as a disgrace and keeps doting on the daughter they had raised, Aisha. Aisha had known the secret for years and concealed the lab report. Pooja locates the maternity ward records showing Aisha's mother bribed a nurse to switch the infants. At the family's fundraising dinner, she exposes the records. The wealthy matriarch has to admit before everyone that she picked the wrong daughter.
